name: Valley Cell-Based Clustering Transfer Function Design
aliases: Automated TF Design with Valley Cell-Based Clustering
definition: A method for automatically generating opacity transfer functions for volume rendering by clustering 2D density plots (value vs. gradient magnitude or other features) into valley cells, computing a persistence hierarchy, and mapping these clusters to Gaussian transfer functions with depth-aware opacity.
summary: Valley Cell-Based Clustering Transfer Function Design automatically generates multidimensional transfer functions by decomposing density plots into topological valley cells, using cell persistence to hierarchically simplify the feature space and mitigate noise.
